verdict.rationale: Phaser itself is an open-source library where all game code/assets are plain JS/TS/JSON files already under the developer's control, and the paid Editor explicitly states games are 'not linked to the licence' and project files can be transferred to VS Code, addressing lock-in concerns for that add-on tool. However, there is no dedicated 'export all your data' feature, no data-portability documentation, and no evidence about exporting editor-specific project metadata or cloud-stored assets in open formats. Missing for 10: explicit data-export tooling/documentation, confirmation that all editor-generated project data (not just code) is stored/exportable in open formats, and independent corroboration of frictionless migration away from Phaser's paid tools.
